2026_surface_mesh_tools/docs/collision_detection/04_ray_grid_traversal ...
1. Purpose The structured grid accelerates a ray query only if the program can visit the cells crossed by the ray in the correct order. The intended method is a three-dimensional digital differential analyzer, normally abbreviated 3D DDA. It is also called voxel traversal or grid traversal.
